wording.hookAsk: Which hero of myth and legend {hook}?

deed.pick: Which of these is the legend of {label}?
deed.match: Match each hero of myth and legend to the legend they are known for.
deed.reverse: Which hero of myth and legend fits this: {value}?

rows.label: Odysseus
rows.deed: spent ten years sailing home after the Trojan War
rows.description: legendary Greek king of Ithaca
rows.hook: is the cunning Greek king and hero of Homer's Odyssey, nicknamed the Cunning

rows.label: Achilles
rows.deed: was undone by an arrow to his one weak spot
rows.description: Greek mythological hero of the Trojan War
rows.hook: is the central hero of Homer's Iliad, son of a sea nymph and the greatest Greek warrior

rows.label: Robin Hood
rows.deed: robbed the rich to feed the poor in Sherwood Forest
rows.description: heroic outlaw in English folklore, a highly skilled archer and swordsman
rows.hook: is a legendary archer outlaw who is said to have defied the Sheriff of Nottingham

rows.label: Heracles
rows.deed: completed twelve impossible labors
rows.description: divine hero in Greek mythology, son of Zeus and Alcmene
rows.hook: is the Greek hero of superhuman strength, famous for a dozen great labours

rows.label: Gilgamesh
rows.deed: a king who set out to find immortality
rows.description: Sumerian ruler and protagonist of the Epic of Gilgamesh

rows.label: Sun Wukong
rows.deed: stole the peaches of immortality and fought heaven itself
rows.description: mythical character from Journey to the West
rows.hook: is the Monkey King, born from a stone, who escorts a monk on a quest for Buddhist scriptures

rows.label: Orpheus
rows.deed: charmed the underworld with his lyre to try to rescue his wife
rows.description: legendary musician, poet, and prophet in ancient Greek religion and myth
rows.hook: is a Thracian bard whose music could charm all living things and even stones

rows.label: Perseus
rows.deed: cut off the head of Medusa
rows.description: legendary Greek hero and founder of Mycenae, demigod son of Zeus and Danae; famous for beheading the Gorgon Medusa
rows.hook: is the Greek demigod who beheaded a snake-haired Gorgon and rescued Andromeda from a sea monster

rows.label: Theseus
rows.deed: killed the bull-headed monster of the labyrinth
rows.description: legendary king of Athens, son of Aegeus and Aethra; famous for slaying the Minotaur
rows.hook: is the legendary king of Athens who united Attica after many adventures on the road

rows.label: Oedipus
rows.deed: answered the Sphinx riddle and became king of Thebes
rows.description: mythical Greek king of Thebes
rows.hook: is the tragic king who unknowingly fulfilled a prophecy that he would kill his father and marry his mother

rows.label: Hector
rows.deed: defended Troy until he was slain in single combat
rows.description: prince of Troy in Greek mythology
rows.hook: is the greatest Trojan warrior, killed by Achilles and dragged behind a chariot

rows.label: Aeneas
rows.deed: fled burning Troy and became the ancestor of Rome
rows.description: Trojan hero, son of Anchises and Aphrodite
rows.hook: is the Trojan hero at the center of Virgil's epic and the forefather of Romulus and Remus

rows.label: William Tell
rows.deed: shot an apple off his own son head
rows.description: folk hero of Switzerland
rows.hook: is a crossbow-wielding folk hero who defied a Habsburg reeve and is called father of a confederation

rows.label: Cú Chulainn
rows.deed: held off a whole army alone in Ulster
rows.description: Irish mythological hero
rows.hook: is an Irish warrior hero and demigod whose name means Hound of Culann

rows.label: Jason
rows.deed: sailed with the Argonauts to fetch the Golden Fleece
rows.description: Greek mythological hero, son of Aeson
rows.hook: is the Greek hero, rightful heir of Iolcos, who married the sorceress Medea

rows.label: Romulus
rows.deed: founded a city after killing his twin brother
rows.description: legendary founder and first king of Rome
rows.hook: is the legendary first king of Rome, credited with its oldest laws and institutions

rows.label: Galahad
rows.deed: found the Holy Grail
rows.description: knight of the round table
rows.hook: is the purest knight of King Arthur's Round Table, son of Lancelot

rows.label: Sigurd
rows.deed: slew the dragon Fafnir
rows.description: fictional character in Germanic and Norse heroic legend, dragon slayer
rows.hook: is the Norse form of the German hero Siegfried, nicknamed the horn-skinned

rows.label: Atalanta
rows.deed: won a footrace and hunted the Calydonian boar
rows.description: Greek mythological character, the only female Argonaut
rows.hook: is a huntress allied to Artemis, known for her speed and as the lone woman among a famous crew

rows.label: Fionn mac Cumhaill
rows.deed: gained wisdom from the Salmon of Knowledge
rows.description: Irish mythical hero
rows.hook: is the Irish leader of the Fianna hunter-warriors, a seer and poet with a magic thumb

rows.label: Bellerophon
rows.deed: tamed a winged horse and slew the Chimera
rows.description: Hero in Greek myth who rode Pegasus and killed the Chimera
rows.hook: is a Corinthian son of Poseidon who angered the gods by trying to fly to Olympus

rows.label: Cadmus
rows.deed: sowed dragon teeth that grew into warriors
rows.description: mythological founder of Thebes, son of Agenor
rows.hook: is the legendary Phoenician prince who founded a Greek city after searching for his abducted sister Europa
